race.comment: PLANET NERO (4) sets the standard after winning his Class 1 on debut at this track and trip by three lengths, despite beginning slowly and starting at generous odds. The margin and manner of that win give him the clearest upside, with the winning rider staying aboard. GLORYESS (9) is the main danger after finishing within two lengths in a BM66 at Quirindi at big odds, and he has a prior win around this distance plus a solid record with Billy Cray. Maps well again. RENOIR (3) has to rebound from a plain Wyong BM64 run, but the return to his winning track and trip and the booking of Aaron Bullock make him dangerous. JASON DARREN (1) has been honest in BM66 grade, including a last-start third at Port Macquarie, and the apprentice claim helps offset the top weight, though 1750m is new ground for him.
